name: National Human Rights Commission (國家人權委員會)
org: National Human Rights Commission, Control Yuan
what: Takes complaints from people who have experienced human rights violations, torture or discrimination, and runs Taiwan's independent mechanism for monitoring the Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (CRPD).
how: File a complaint online through the NHRC Complaint Filing System, by email or post using the complaint form, or in person at the Complaint Receipt Center on the 1st floor of the Control Yuan (weekdays 9:00-12:00 and 13:30-17:00).
evidence_note: Own complaint-process page lists filing channels and says victims of rights violations or discrimination can complain; CRPD page describes its monitoring role; footer lists the complaint hotline.

name: Authorized Person of the Oliy Majlis for Human Rights (Ombudsman)
org: Ombudsman of the Republic of Uzbekistan
what: The national human rights ombudsman receives citizens' appeals, including complaints about officials' actions, labour and legal matters, at its central office and through regional representatives.
how: Call the short number 1096 or (71) 200-10-96, email ombudsman1@umail.uz, or visit the Tashkent office or a regional representative's reception (Mon-Fri 09:00-13:00, 14:00-18:00).
evidence_note: Own contact page lists hotline 1096, phone, email and hours; own news item says the Ombudsman continues to receive citizens' appeals in person centrally and regionally.

name: Mécanisme national de protection des droits des personnes en situation de handicap (National Mechanism for the Protection of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities)
org: Conseil National des Droits de l'Homme (CNDH)
what: Hosted by Morocco's National Human Rights Council, it accepts complaints from persons with disabilities who are victims of rights violations (or from their representatives or third parties), investigates them and decides on each case.
how: Contact the CNDH in Rabat by phone or email, or write to 22, Rue Riyad, Quartier Riyad, BP 21527, Rabat.
evidence_note: Own mechanism page says it accepts and investigates complaints from persons with disabilities; lists CNDH phone, fax, email and address.

name: Procurador de los Derechos Humanos (PDH) (Human Rights Ombudsman)
org: Procuraduría de los Derechos Humanos de Guatemala
what: Guatemala's human rights ombudsman ensures respect for people's rights and takes complaints (denuncias) from anyone who has suffered a human rights violation.
how: Call the complaints line 1555 or use the denuncia and call-center links on the PDH website.
evidence_note: Own homepage identifies the PDH and has denuncia and call-center links; UNHCR Guatemala help page lists complaints line 1555 and information line.

name: Comisionado Nacional de los Derechos Humanos (CONADEH) (National Human Rights Commissioner)
org: CONADEH
what: Honduras's national human rights institution receives complaints (quejas) about human rights violations and reports on the barriers persons with disabilities face.
how: Submit a complaint through the online form on the CONADEH website or visit the central office at Colonia Humuya, avenida Sabana, edificio San José Anexo, Tegucigalpa.
evidence_note: Own site has a complaint form page and central office address; homepage carries a 2026 item on persons with disabilities; no phone shown.

name: Defensoría del Pueblo (Ombudsman)
org: Defensoría del Pueblo del Estado Plurinacional de Bolivia
what: Bolivia's ombudsman takes complaints through a complaint form and its Sistema de Servicio al Pueblo, has a section on persons with disabilities, and offers service in Bolivian Sign Language.
how: Call the free line 800 10 8004, email correspondencia@defensoria.gob.bo, use the complaint form on the website, or visit Calle Colombia N°440, Zona San Pedro, La Paz.
evidence_note: Own homepage lists free line, phones, email, address, a complaint form link, a persons with disabilities section and a sign-language service.

name: Fiji Human Rights and Anti-Discrimination Commission (FHRADC)
org: Fiji Human Rights and Anti-Discrimination Commission
what: Fiji's national human rights and anti-discrimination body takes complaints through an online form and has a disability rights section explaining the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2018, including disability discrimination.
how: Lodge a complaint with the online form on the website, call 330 8577, or visit Level 2 Naibati House, 9 Goodenough Street, Suva.
evidence_note: Own homepage has a Lodge a Complaint form link, phone and address; disability rights page summarises the 2018 Act's disability discrimination definition.

name: Commission on Human Rights and Public Administration
org: Government of Eswatini
what: Investigates complaints of violations of constitutional rights and freedoms, and complaints of injustice, abuse of power or unfair treatment by public officers or failures in public services.
how: File a complaint in writing through the office of the commissioner at Mbabane Office Park, Sibekelo Building (P.O. Box 8795, Mbabane), or call the office.
evidence_note: Government of Eswatini page for the Commission describes its complaint-investigation functions and lists address and phones.

name: Office of the Ombudsman Tonga
org: Office of the Ombudsman, Kingdom of Tonga
what: Investigates complaints about administrative actions and decisions of any government ministry, department, organisation or public enterprise.
how: Complain by letter, email, phone (toll-free 0800-662) or the online complaint form at form.ombudsman.to.
evidence_note: Own homepage says it investigates complaints about public bodies and lists letter, email, phone and online form; toll-free number shown.

name: Всероссийское общество инвалидов (ВОИ) (All-Russian Society of Disabled People)
org: All-Russian Society of Disabled People
what: A national membership organization of people with disabilities with UN ECOSOC consultative status; its site offers free legal help information and guidance on registering disability and getting assistive devices.
how: Contact the Moscow office by phone or use the citizen appeals page on the website.
evidence_note: Own homepage describes the society, a free legal help section and citizen appeals page; lists Moscow address and phone.

name: National Council of and For Persons with Disabilities (NCPD)
org: National Council of and For Persons with Disabilities
what: An umbrella organization coordinating disability groups across Saint Lucia that works for equal rights and also makes subsidized prosthetic legs, offers physical therapy and referrals, and distributes mobility aids.
how: Call or email the office at Apricot Lane, Carellie, Castries.
evidence_note: Government Parastatal Monitoring Department statutory-body page describes NCPD as umbrella body with services and lists contacts; no NCPD own site found.
decision_note: personal free-mail address left off

name: Cambodian Disabled People's Organisation (CDPO)
org: Cambodian Disabled People's Organisation
what: The national membership network of disabled people's organizations (56 member DPOs and federations, including Women with Disabilities Forums) that advocates for disability rights and keeps a directory of DPOs.
how: Call or email the Phnom Penh office (Mon-Fri 8:00-12:00, 13:30-17:00).
evidence_note: Own site lists address, phone, email and DPO directory; CCC NGO database describes it as a network of 56 member DPOs doing rights advocacy.

name: Disability Affairs, Department of Social Development
org: Ministry of Public Service, Labour and Social Welfare
what: Through district Social Welfare offices it helps persons with disabilities with medical treatment vouchers (AMTO), assistive devices such as wheelchairs and crutches through the Disability Fund, loans and grants, school fees under BEAM and vocational training at National Rehabilitation Centres.
how: Apply at your Department of Social Welfare district office with a birth certificate, national ID and proof of disability from a government hospital, or call the toll-free line 1980.
evidence_note: Own Disability Affairs page lists services, documents needed, toll-free number, phones and email.

name: بطاقة الخدمات المتكاملة للأشخاص ذوي الإعاقة (Integrated Services Card for Persons with Disabilities)
org: Ministry of Social Solidarity
what: A card for persons with disabilities that gives access to benefits such as the 5% government jobs quota, free hospital examinations, school and university inclusion, and customs and tax exemptions on assistive devices and a vehicle.
how: Apply online for a first card or check a request on the Ministry's card portal, or call the card hotline 15044.
evidence_note: Ministry card portal lists card benefits and online application; Ministry homepage lists card hotline 15044.

name: Commission for Equal Rights of Persons with Disabilities
org: Ministry of Justice, State of Israel
what: Handles inquiries and complaints about discrimination against disabled people and about accessibility; it can investigate, take civil or criminal action, and give advice and representation in employment matters.
how: Contact the Commission's public inquiries unit, or submit an inquiry or complaint through its gov.il service pages.
evidence_note: Kol Zchut rights guide describes the Commission's complaint, enforcement and advice role; gov.il service pages would not load; its phone entry looked incomplete so none is given.

name: Komnas HAM (Komisi Nasional Hak Asasi Manusia, National Human Rights Commission)
org: Komnas HAM
what: Indonesia's national human rights institution; it monitors and investigates human rights and has a complaints and mediation function.
how: File a complaint through the Komnas HAM online complaint portal (pengaduan.komnasham.go.id) or write to the commission.
evidence_note: Asia Pacific Forum member page lists mandate, complaints and mediation sub-committee, website and email; own site would not load except the online complaint portal title.

name: Fogyatékossági támogatás (Disability support)
org: Magyar Államkincstár (Hungarian State Treasury) and the government offices (kormányhivatal)
what: A monthly support payment for severely disabled adults aged 18 or older, covering motor, visual, hearing and intellectual disability, severe autism and chromosomal disorders.
how: Submit the application form with a GP referral and medical proof to the government office for your area, in person at a kormányablak, by post or electronically; call 1811 for information.
evidence_note: Government offices page lists disability support with ways to apply and call centre 1811; MEOSZ guide gives eligibility and documents needed.

name: Novčana naknada za pomoć i negu drugog lica (Attendance allowance)
org: Republički fond za penzijsko i invalidsko osiguranje (PIO Fund)
what: A monthly cash allowance for insured people and pensioners who need another person's help with basic daily needs, such as blind people, people who cannot move around, eat or dress without help, and people on dialysis; it does not depend on income.
how: Use the application form from the PIO Fund website's forms section; the Fund's medical body assesses the need for care.
evidence_note: PIO Fund cash benefits page describes the allowance, eligibility, how to apply, contact line and email.

name: Office of the Ombudsman
org: Office of the Ombudsman, Namibia
what: Investigates complaints from individuals about human rights violations and maladministration in the public sector.
how: Lodge a complaint in person, by phone or email, through the online complaint form, by Facebook message or by SMS.
evidence_note: Own mandate page covers human rights complaints from individuals; contact page lists Windhoek phone, email and regional offices.
decision_note: own link not among the pages read

name: Department for Social Inclusion of Persons with Disabilities (Τμήμα Κοινωνικής Ενσωμάτωσης Ατόμων με Αναπηρίες)
org: Ministry of Labour, Welfare and Social Insurance, Republic of Cyprus
what: The national disability department; it carries out disability and functioning assessments and certification and grants social benefits to persons with disabilities.
how: Call or email the department.
evidence_note: Department's About page on its European Disability Card site lists its responsibilities, phone and email.

name: Государственное социальное пособие по инвалидности (State social disability benefit)
org: Ministry of Labour and Social Protection of the Population
what: A free state service that assigns the monthly state social benefit for disability.
how: Apply online through the eGov portal with an electronic signature, at a 'Government for Citizens' service centre, or at a regional labour and social protection office.
evidence_note: Government services page names the ministry, application channels and processing time.

name: National Institution for Human Rights
org: National Institution for Human Rights, Kingdom of Bahrain
what: Bahrain's independent national human rights body; it receives and examines complaints from individuals, relatives and representatives and monitors places of detention.
how: Contact the institution by phone to make a complaint.
evidence_note: Own About page says it receives complaints from individuals and shows phone numbers.

name: Disabled People's Organization of Bhutan (DPOB)
org: Disabled People's Organization of Bhutan (formerly Disabled Persons' Association of Bhutan)
what: Bhutan's national organization run by persons with disabilities; it registers members and runs advocacy, health, education, skills, community and Deaf programmes.
how: Register as a member or contact the office in Thimphu by phone or email.
evidence_note: Own About page describes the organization, programmes and contact details.
decision_note: own link not among the pages read

name: Commission Nationale Indépendante des Droits de l'Homme (CNIDH, National Independent Human Rights Commission)
org: CNIDH Madagascar
what: Madagascar's national human rights institution; it receives and examines complaints about human rights violations.
how: Complain by letter, email, the website form, phone or in person at the office in Antananarivo; phone or oral complaints must be confirmed in writing.
evidence_note: Own Protection page says it receives complaints and lists ways to file; contact page lists the protection service phone and email.

name: Akyikatchy (Ombudsman) of the Kyrgyz Republic
org: Institute of the Akyikatchy (Ombudsman)
what: Provides parliamentary oversight of citizens' rights and freedoms and considers signed written appeals about rights violations by state bodies.
how: Send a signed written appeal with your full name and address, a description of the decision or action and copies of relevant documents.
evidence_note: Own pages describe the rights oversight role and what an appeal must contain; no contact details shown.
decision_note: own link not among the pages read

name: Office of the Ombudsman
org: Office of the Ombudsman, Lesotho
what: Receives and investigates complaints from anyone who feels wronged by a government agency, statutory corporation or their officials.
how: Contact the office at Moposo House, Maseru, by phone or email.
evidence_note: Own home page explains complaints from aggrieved persons and lists address, phone and email.

name: Commission des Droits de l'Homme du Cameroun (Cameroon Human Rights Commission)
org: Cameroon Human Rights Commission
what: Cameroon's institution for the promotion and protection of human rights and the prevention of torture, created by law in 2019; it refers cases brought before it to the justice authorities.
how: Contact the Commission in Yaoundé by phone or email.
evidence_note: Own home page gives its protection mandate, address, phone and email; ACERWC profile says it refers cases brought before it.

name: Orthopaedic devices and prostheses (Istituto per la Sicurezza Sociale)
org: Istituto per la Sicurezza Sociale (ISS)
what: San Marino's social security institute supplies or reimburses medical materials, orthopaedic devices and prostheses on specialist prescription, subject to eligibility.
how: Get a specialist's prescription and submit it with clinical documents and invoices to the ISS unit that handles reimbursements.
evidence_note: Own ISS citizen guide describes supply and reimbursement of devices and prostheses and the procedure.

name: Ministry of National Mobilisation, Social Development, Gender Affairs and Persons with Disabilities
org: Government of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
what: The ministry responsible for persons with disabilities; in March 2025 the government announced a disability unit within it to provide support, advocacy and services.
how: Contact the ministry on Halifax Street, Kingstown, by phone or email. On the main line, ask for extension 3863.
evidence_note: Ministry page lists contacts; ministry PDF announces the planned disability unit (not yet confirmed operating).
decision_note: extension moved from the phone field into how

name: Defensor del Pueblo (Ombudsman)
org: Defensor del Pueblo de la República Dominicana
what: Takes complaints (reclamaciones) against public institutions and public service providers and gives citizens guidance on their rights.
how: Call or WhatsApp, email, or visit the office on Av. 27 de Febrero in Santo Domingo, Monday to Friday 8 a.m. to 4 p.m.
evidence_note: Own services page describes the complaints service; contacts page lists phone, WhatsApp, email and address.
decision_note: own link not among the pages read

name: National Human Rights Commission of Thailand
org: Office of the National Human Rights Commission of Thailand
what: Takes complaints about human rights violations, including from people whose rights have been violated. Complaints can be made by letter, phone, hotline, in person, fax or online.
how: Call the 1377 hotline, file online at complaints.nhrc.or.th, or visit the office in Lak Si, Bangkok.
evidence_note: Own 'File a human rights complaint' page lists hotline 1377, phones 0 2141 3800 / 0 2141 3900, online form and office address.

name: National Commission for Human Rights (NCHR)
org: National Commission for Human Rights, Republic of Rwanda
what: Receives, examines and investigates complaints about human rights violations; its monitoring covers persons with disabilities among other groups.
how: File a complaint online through the 'file a complaint' option on the Commission's website, or call the toll-free line 3430.
evidence_note: Own pages give online complaint steps, toll-free 3430, info@cndp.org.rw, and state the duty to investigate complaints; monitoring explicitly covers persons with disabilities.
decision_note: own link not among the pages read

name: Oman Human Rights Commission (OHRC)
org: Oman Human Rights Commission
what: Receives and follows up reports of human rights issues in Oman, and runs work on the rights of persons with disabilities such as sign language programmes and training on the disability convention.
how: Submit a report through the online complaint form (written or voice) on the Commission's website.
evidence_note: Own site links a complaint form (text and voice options) and lists disability-rights activities; no phone or email shown.

name: Human Rights Commission of the Maldives (HRCM)
org: Human Rights Commission of the Maldives
what: Takes human rights complaints and is listed on its own disability page among the agencies that assist persons with disabilities.
how: Call the 1424 hotline, submit a complaint through the website, or visit the office in Malé (08:00-14:00).
evidence_note: Own homepage has a 'Submit a complaint' section; contact page lists hotline 1424 and phone 3336539; disability page lists HRCM with 1424.

name: Raonador del Ciutadà (Citizen's Ombudsman)
org: Institució del Raonador del Ciutadà del Principat d'Andorra
what: Andorra's ombudsman: handles complaints and claims against Andorran institutions and bodies, and does human rights promotion work.
how: Use the online complaint form on the website or call the free number 18003030 (Monday to Friday, 8:00-15:00).
evidence_note: Own homepage has 'Presenteu una reclamació' form, free phone 18003030, phone +376 810 585 and email; IOI member page confirms address in Andorra la Vella.

name: Office of the Ombudsman
org: Government of Botswana
what: Investigates complaints of improper administrative conduct by public authorities and recommends remedies where a complainant has suffered injustice, as an alternative to the courts.
how: Call the toll-free line or visit the Gaborone office (Main Mall) or regional offices in Francistown, Maun and Tsabong, 07:30-16:30 weekdays.
evidence_note: Government page describes complaint investigation role and lists toll-free (+267) 0800 600 014 and Gaborone tel (+267) 3953322; email shown obfuscated so omitted.

name: Conseil National des Droits de l'Homme (CNDH) (National Human Rights Council)
org: Conseil National des Droits de l'Homme de Côte d'Ivoire
what: Receives complaints and reports of human rights violations and carries out non-judicial investigations into them; it has a complaints department (Département des requêtes) and a green line for reporting.
how: Call the Council or visit its office at Cocody 2 Plateaux Vallon, Rue J95, Abidjan.
evidence_note: Own 'Qui sommes-nous' page lists receiving complaints among its missions; homepage shows phones, email and address. Some other subpages of cndh.ci carry injected gambling spam; do not link those.
decision_note: personal free-mail address left off

name: Commission Nationale des Droits de l'Homme (CNDH-RDC) (National Human Rights Commission)
org: Commission Nationale des Droits de l'Homme, République démocratique du Congo
what: Receives and handles complaints about human rights violations.
how: File a complaint with the online form on the 'Déposer une plainte' page, or visit the office on Boulevard du 30 juin, Kinshasa (Monday to Friday, 8:00-16:00).
evidence_note: Own homepage says it receives and treats complaints, links an online complaint form, lists contact@cndh.cd and address; only officials' personal lines shown, so no phone given.

name: Malawi Human Rights Commission (MHRC)
org: Malawi Human Rights Commission
what: Takes complaints from anyone concerned about a human rights violation, abuse of power or maladministration by public institutions; disability and elderly rights is one of its thematic areas.
how: File a complaint online at complaints.mhrcmw.org, message the 24/7 WhatsApp line, or visit H.B. House, Lilongwe.
evidence_note: Own homepage invites complaints with an online portal, lists phone +265 1 750 900, WhatsApp +265 899 81 96 85, email and 'Disability and Elderly Rights' theme.

name: Médiateur de la République (Ombudsman of the Republic)
org: Médiature de la République du Sénégal
what: Independent authority that takes written complaints from any person who believes a public body (state administration, local authority or public service organisation) failed them; referral is free.
how: Send a written complaint (réclamation) or visit 22 Rue Vincens angle Faidherbe, Dakar, Monday to Friday 8:00-16:00.
evidence_note: Own homepage lists phones (221) 33 921 12 50 / 33 822 55 63, email and address; government portal page describes free written complaints against public bodies.

name: Office of the Ombudsman
org: Government of St. Kitts and Nevis
what: Investigates citizens' complaints about the administrative actions of government departments and public bodies, decides whether there was maladministration and makes recommendations; set up to protect and enforce citizens' rights.
how: Contact the Office of the Ombudsman through the Government of St. Kitts and Nevis (Government Headquarters, Church Street, Basseterre).
evidence_note: Government page describes the complaints role; contact block on page is the general government one, so no phone given.

name: National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) of The Gambia
org: National Human Rights Commission, The Gambia
what: Receives complaints of human rights violations, which can be reported confidentially, and works to advance the rights of persons with disabilities.
how: File a complaint online through the 'File a Complaint' form on the website and track it on the Complaint Dashboard, or contact the Secretariat in Kotu.
evidence_note: Own homepage has complaint form and dashboard, Secretariat (+220) 446 1717 and 5200272, email and P.O. Box address. Added under rights because no start body could be traced; existing GM rights row is the Act, not an institution.

name: Yusr national digital platform for persons with disabilities
org: Ministry of Social Development and Family (MSDF), developed with Mada Center for Assistive Technology
what: A single digital gateway giving persons with disabilities, their families and caregivers access to specialised services and accessible information from the relevant authorities.
how: Go to yusr.msdf.gov.qa.
evidence_note: Ministry's own news page announces Yusr (launched 4 Dec 2025) and gives its address; platform itself not opened.
decision_note: own link not among the pages read

name: Consejo Nacional de Personas con Discapacidad (CONAPDIS) (National Council of Persons with Disabilities)
org: Government of Costa Rica
what: National disability council that issues disability certification (certificación de discapacidad) and the disability card; first-time applicants attach a medical certificate or similar document from the CCSS.
how: Apply to CONAPDIS for disability certification with a CCSS medical certificate, epicrisis or a report from your treating specialist.
evidence_note: Own site would not load (robots unreachable); Ministry of Labour press release describes CONAPDIS certification and Article 7 document requirements. Contacts on that page are the Ministry's, so none given.

name: Министерство за социјална политика, демографија и млади (Ministry of Social Policy, Demography and Youth)
org: Government of North Macedonia
what: Ministry responsible for social protection, including protection of people with developmental disabilities, civilian and war-disabled persons, and pension and disability insurance.
how: Contact the ministry by phone or email, or at 14 Dame Gruev Str., Skopje.
evidence_note: Government portal page lists the ministry's disability-related duties, website, email, phone 02 3117 288 and address; ministry site not opened.

name: بطاقة ذوي الإعاقة (Disability Card)
org: Ministry of Social Affairs and Labour
what: Official card with no expiry that gives free or subsidised treatment in public hospitals, priority for prosthetics and hearing aids, reduced public transport fares, fee exemptions (including court fees), and the basis for the 4% job quota and ministry vocational training.
how: Take a copy of your ID, recent photos, medical reports and the application form to the Social Affairs and Labour directorate in your governorate for assessment by its medical committee.
evidence_note: State news agency SANA articles describe the ministry's card, benefits and how to apply; no ministry website could be traced, so url is the SANA article (flag for review).
decision_note: only a state news article supports it; no ministry page could be traced

name: National Human Rights Institution (NHRI)
org: UAE National Human Rights Institution
what: The UAE's national human rights institution; the government's official portal directs human rights complaints to it.
how: Use the institution's website, or report a human rights issue through the channels listed on the u.ae 'Report discrimination' page.
evidence_note: Own site loads only a JavaScript shell; official u.ae portal directs human rights complaints to the NHRI and Dubai Media Office page gives its web address.

name: Equal Opportunities Commission (EOC)
org: Equal Opportunities Commission, Hong Kong
what: Takes complaints of disability discrimination under the Disability Discrimination Ordinance; the hotline or email can help you prepare a written complaint.
how: Lodge a written complaint by the EOC online form, fax, post or in person, or call the enquiry hotline for help.
evidence_note: EOC's own site would not load (robots unreachable); CLIC legal information page lists EOC hotline, complaint email, address and how to complain about disability discrimination.

name: National Human Rights Commission of Mongolia
org: National Human Rights Commission of Mongolia
what: Independent national human rights institution that receives complaints about human rights violations; children and people with limited legal capacity can complain through a guardian or representative.
how: File a complaint in writing or in person, or through the Commission's official email or hotline, generally within two years of the violation.
evidence_note: Own pages describe its mandate and the law's complaint rules (who may file, how, time limit); no contact numbers printed on them.

name: Human Rights Commission of Sierra Leone (HRCSL)
org: Human Rights Commission of Sierra Leone
what: Sierra Leone's national human rights institution, set up in 2004; its remit includes protecting the rights of persons with disabilities, and in 2024 it agreed a complaints-handling arrangement with the National Commission for Persons with Disability.
how: Contact the Commission in Freetown by phone, or through its website.
evidence_note: Own site confirms it is the official HRCSL site but shows no complaint details; African Disability Rights Yearbook 2024 describes its disability remit and NCPD complaints MoU; ACHPR listing gives phone.

name: Defensoría del Pueblo (Ombudsman)
org: Defensoría del Pueblo de la República del Paraguay
what: Takes complaints from anyone who has suffered an unjust situation or a violation of their human rights.
how: Fill in the online complaint form (denuncia) on its website, write by email, message by WhatsApp, or visit the office in Asunción.
evidence_note: Own complaints page has the online form, WhatsApp number, email and address (Avda. Ygatimi N° 705 esq. Juan E. O'Leary, Asunción).

name: National Human Rights Commission (NHRC)
org: National Human Rights Commission, Mauritius
what: Mauritius's national human rights institution; its Human Rights Division takes complaints from the public through a complaint form.
how: Use the 'Make a Complaint' form on its website, or call or email the Human Rights Division (3rd Floor, Ebene Heights, Ebene).
evidence_note: Own site has a Make a Complaint form and lists Human Rights Division phone and email; a 2014 disability rights yearbook notes its constitutional mandate has no disability-specific clause.

name: الهيئة الوطنية لحقوق الإنسان (National Human Rights Commission)
org: National Human Rights Commission of Lebanon
what: Lebanon's national human rights institution; it takes human rights complaints and has a committee on the rights of persons with disabilities.
how: Submit a complaint on the online form (victim, or a representative or family member with consent), or call the office or hotline in Beirut.
evidence_note: Own site has an online human rights complaint form, a disability rights committee, and contact page with phone, hotline 00961 3 923 456 and email.

name: 中国残疾人联合会 (China Disabled Persons' Federation, CDPF)
org: China Disabled Persons' Federation
what: National federation that represents and safeguards the rights and interests of persons with disabilities; disabled persons' federations run legal aid stations and a nationwide 12385 service hotline for persons with disabilities.
how: Call the 12385 hotline for persons with disabilities or contact your local disabled persons' federation.
evidence_note: Own site would not load; government white paper page (2019) describes CDPF's rights role, legal aid stations and the 12385 hotline.

name: Liechtensteiner Behinderten-Verband (LBV) and its Büro für die Gleichstellung von Menschen mit Behinderungen (Office for the Equality of People with Disabilities)
org: Liechtensteiner Behinderten-Verband
what: The national disability association hosts the equality office that is the contact point for official matters such as grants and complaints; the association also helps with legal and insurance matters, building advice, wheelchair transport and financial assistance.
how: Call or email the LBV office in Schaan (Wiesengass 17), Monday to Friday 8:00-11:30 and 13:30-16:00.
evidence_note: Government (llv.li) pages say the equality office at the LBV handles complaints; LBV's own page gives phone, email, address and hours.

name: Provedor de Direitos Humanos e Justiça (PDHJ, Ombudsman for Human Rights and Justice)
org: Provedoria dos Direitos Humanos e Justiça
what: Takes complaints from people whose rights were violated by a decision, action or official of a public authority, and reports of poor governance.
how: Complain online, phone the Dili headquarters, write to or visit Dili or a regional office (Baucau, Maliana, RAEOA, Manufahi), or use the complaint box at district administration offices.
evidence_note: Own site lists ways to complain (online form, phone 3331184, regional offices, complaint boxes) and contact +670 333 1071, info@pdhj.tl.

name: المركز الوطني لحقوق الإنسان (National Centre for Human Rights, NCHR)
org: National Centre for Human Rights, Jordan
what: Jordan's national human rights institution; it receives human rights complaints from all residents of Jordan.
how: Submit a complaint on the NCHR online complaint platform, or call or email the Centre.
